items.tagline: Scheduling that respects everyone's calendar — one link, real availability, zero back-and-forth.
items.name: ExitQ
items.description: ExitQ is scheduling built for teams who actually keep a calendar. It checks every connected calendar before offering a time, so a busy slot never appears — and visitors always see times in their own timezone, with daylight saving worked out per date. Set working hours, meeting lengths, buffers and daily/weekly/monthly booking limits, then share one link for every meeting type you offer. For teams, ExitQ supports Collective bookings (everyone must be free) and Round Robin (goes to whoever has the lightest week). Every booking creates a customer record with full meeting history, and any meeting type can carry a fixed price that locks in at the moment of booking.

statsList.label: Calendar checked before a slot shows

items.shortDescription: ExitQ reads every calendar your team has connected and offers only the times you're genuinely free — in the visitor's own timezone, confirmed the moment they choose.
highlightsList: Checks every connected calendar before offering a time — no double-booked slots
Automatic timezone detection with per-date daylight-saving handling
Collective and Round Robin team booking types
Daily, weekly & monthly meeting limits with custom buffers
Built-in customer records with full meeting history
Paid meetings with the price locked at the moment of booking
Strict transaction locking — two people can never claim the same slot
Works with Google Calendar, Outlook, Zoom, Google Meet, Razorpay, Telegram & WhatsApp
items.seoTitle: ExitQ — Scheduling That Respects Everyone's Calendar
items.seoDescription: One link, real availability, zero back-and-forth. ExitQ checks every connected calendar before offering a time, handles timezones automatically, and confirms bookings instantly.

items.tagline: AI-powered project management with Telegram alerts & push notifications
items.name: Sprintag
items.description: Sprintag brings AI-powered project creation, team management, Telegram alerts and push notifications into one unified workspace, built for teams that move fast. Describe a project in plain English and Sprintag's AI Project Generator instantly creates phases, milestones and tasks. Every organisation gets a fully isolated, white-label-ready workspace with 5-tier role-based access (Owner, Admin, Manager, Member, Viewer), plus a native-feel mobile app for iOS and Android. Sprintag also exposes a full MCP server and OpenAPI REST API, so teams can manage projects through Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini using natural language.

Telegram bot alerts for task assignments, mentions & deadlines
Push notifications on Android, even when the app is closed
Gantt chart & calendar views for every project timeline
Bulk import from CSV/Excel — up to 5,000 rows
MCP server + REST API — manage projects from Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini
Native mobile app for iOS & Android with 18+ screens

items.tagline: Simple, fast CRM for contacts, deals, tasks, and teams — on Web & Mobile.
items.name: ZigCRM
items.description: ZigCRM is a smart, simple CRM built for growing teams to manage contacts, deals, tasks, and their team, all in one place. It is available on Web and Mobile, built for speed, and designed for results. ZigCRM is made up of three connected surfaces: a Web Admin App (full-featured browser-based admin panel that works on any device), a backend platform (the multi-tenant service that powers both web and mobile and keeps every organization's data isolated), and a Mobile App (native apps for iPhone and Android). ZigCRM is a true multi-tenant SaaS platform — perfect for agencies, resellers, and enterprise teams managing multiple organizations at once. Each tenant has fully isolated data, and platform admins manage all tenants from a central super admin panel.
